ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio characterized by a predominantly low-intensity black background punctuated by high-intensity white/grey circular clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Concentrated mapping of high-contrast white annular blobs in the central and lower-medial quadrants of both lobes against a continuous dark pigment field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp, deep V-shaped central depression with a narrow acute angle and high vertical depth relative to the horizontal lobe axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the superior boundary; distinct high-amplitude irregular indentation present on the far-left distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong concave upward curve originating from the median notch and extending toward the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of roughly circular, high-contrast annular clusters (white rings on black) across the majority of both visible lobe surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pervasive circular barnacle scarring across ventral surface; significant irregular structural trauma/tissue loss on the far-left trailing edge tip.
